verdict.rationale: Martin documents a 'background tasks' category with predefined scheduled jobs that report back: daily or weekly email briefings and morning wake-up calls with weather and schedule. It also offers one-off reminders that ping you at a set time via a chosen channel. There is no evidence of arbitrary user-defined scheduled tasks, recurring or one-off, that run multi-step work and return results; shortcuts trigger multi-step actions but are not shown to be schedulable. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of custom tasks, scheduled shortcuts or recurring arbitrary actions, task management or result history, independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled execution.
